description: This file defines a static utility class 'DelegateCommandUtils' that provides a method to create delegate commands with weak references to avoid memory leaks, used within the CalculatorApp project.

classes.name: DelegateCommandUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to create delegate commands with weak references.

methods.name: MakeDelegateCommand
methods.description: Creates a DelegateCommand that holds a weak reference to the target object and invokes the handler if the target is still alive.
